card.name: Partway through long medical terms
card.fires_on: Responds to the middle of long technical terms where the word is not yet finished, such as the "-mod" in lipid-modifying and "ulin" in thyroid-binding globulin. It appears in drug interaction and warning sections.

modes.label: Lipid-modifying
modes.description: The "-mod" piece in the phrase lipid-modifying agents or doses.

modes.label: Globulin and peptidases
modes.description: The closing or middle piece of protein names like globulin or endopeptidases.
